title: Robotics Core team
text: The Robotics Core team builds motion planning and safety software for Quillmoor ground robots. The team is led by Priya Natarajan. The team is based in the Austin office. Its on-call rotation lasts 7 days.

title: Robotics Core team (2023 org chart)
text: Archived org chart entry for the Robotics Core team, written before the 2024 reorganization. The team is led by Martin Keller. The team is based in the Denver office. Its on-call rotation lasts 14 days.

title: Robotics Research team
text: The Robotics Research team prototypes grippers, sensors and new robot designs. The team is led by Leon Fischer. The team is based in the Toronto office. Its on-call rotation lasts 21 days.

title: Fulfillment Platform team
text: The Fulfillment Platform team runs order routing and the warehouse software services. The team is led by Tomasz Wierzbicki. The team is based in the Lisbon office. Its on-call rotation lasts 14 days.

title: Fulfillment Platform team (2022 archive)
text: Archived 2022 description of the Fulfillment Platform team. The team is led by Sofia Brandt. The team is based in the Austin office. Its on-call rotation lasts 7 days.

title: Fleet Intelligence team
text: The Fleet Intelligence team builds telemetry pipelines and drone autonomy. The team is led by Amara Okafor. The team is based in the Toronto office. Its on-call rotation lasts 7 days.

title: Customer Reliability team
text: The Customer Reliability team handles escalations from warehouse customers and maintains the support tooling. The team is led by Diego Marin. The team is based in the Austin office. Its on-call rotation lasts 10 days.

title: Payments team
text: The Payments team maintains invoicing and subscription billing for Quillmoor customers. The team is led by Hannah Lindqvist. The team is based in the Lisbon office.

title: Field Operations team
text: The Field Operations team installs and services robots at customer sites. The team is led by Kwame Mensah. The team is based in the Toronto office. Its on-call rotation lasts 5 days.

title: Security Engineering team
text: The Security Engineering team manages certificates, access reviews and penetration tests. The team is led by Yuki Tanaka. The team is based in the Austin office. Its on-call rotation lasts 7 days.

title: Engineering team directory
text: Quillmoor engineering is organized into Robotics Core, Robotics Research, Fulfillment Platform, Fleet Intelligence, Customer Reliability, Payments, Field Operations and Security Engineering. Each team page lists its lead, home office and on-call rotation.

title: Priya Natarajan
text: Priya Natarajan is the director of robotics software. She joined Quillmoor in 2017. She reports to Marcus Hale.

title: Priya Natarajan (2019 profile)
text: Old profile from 2019, when Priya Natarajan was a senior robotics engineer. She joined Quillmoor in 2017. She reports to Martin Keller.

title: Tomasz Wierzbicki
text: Tomasz Wierzbicki is the head of platform engineering. He joined Quillmoor in 2019. He reports to Elena Varga.

title: Amara Okafor
text: Amara Okafor is the director of fleet data. She joined Quillmoor in 2020. She reports to Marcus Hale.

title: Diego Marin
text: Diego Marin is the director of customer reliability. He joined Quillmoor in 2016. He reports to Elena Varga.

title: Hannah Lindqvist
text: Hannah Lindqvist is the payments engineering manager. She joined Quillmoor in 2021. She reports to Elena Varga.

title: Kwame Mensah
text: Kwame Mensah is the head of field operations. He joined Quillmoor in 2018. He reports to Elena Varga.

title: Marcus Hale
text: Marcus Hale is the chief technology officer. He joined Quillmoor in 2014. He reports to Ines Albright.

title: Elena Varga
text: Elena Varga is the chief operating officer. She joined Quillmoor in 2015. She reports to Ines Albright.

title: Austin office
text: The Austin office is located at 400 Congress Avenue. It opened in 2016. Its site manager is Rosa Delgado.

title: Lisbon office
text: The Lisbon office is located at 120 Rua do Ouro. It opened in 2019. Its site manager is Joao Pereira.

title: Toronto office
text: The Toronto office is located at 88 Queens Quay West. It opened in 2020. Its site manager is Liam Chen.

title: Denver office (closed)
text: The Denver office is located at 1700 Larimer Street. It opened in 2012. Its site manager is Greg Holm. The office closed in 2023 and its teams moved to Austin.

title: Office holiday calendar
text: The Austin office closes on Thanksgiving Day. The Lisbon office closes on 13 June for the Santo Antonio festival. The Toronto office closes on Canada Day.

title: Pallet Runner PR-200
text: The Pallet Runner PR-200 is an autonomous pallet mover for narrow aisles. It is owned by the Robotics Core team. It launched in 2021. It carries a maximum payload of 1,200 kg.

title: Pallet Runner PR-200 (2021 launch sheet)
text: Launch sheet for the Pallet Runner PR-200 from 2021. It is owned by the Hardware Labs team. It launched in 2021. It carries a maximum payload of 1,000 kg.

title: Pallet Runner PR-250
text: The Pallet Runner PR-250 is a heavy-duty Pallet Runner for cold storage. It is owned by the Field Operations team. It launched in 2023. It carries a maximum payload of 1,500 kg.

title: SkyLift D3
text: The SkyLift D3 is an indoor inventory drone that scans shelf labels. It is owned by the Fleet Intelligence team. It launched in 2022. It carries a maximum payload of 4 kg.

title: SkyLift D2
text: The SkyLift D2 was the first Quillmoor inventory drone and was discontinued in 2023. It is owned by the Fleet Intelligence team. It launched in 2019. It carries a maximum payload of 3 kg.

title: Atlas WMS
text: Atlas WMS is the warehouse management system that schedules picking and replenishment. It is owned by the Fulfillment Platform team. It is sold as a monthly subscription.

title: Atlas WMS (2020 overview)
text: Overview of Atlas WMS written in 2020, when it was sold as an annual license. It is owned by the Core Services team.

title: TallyScan
text: TallyScan is a handheld scanning app used by warehouse staff. It is owned by the Customer Reliability team. It launched in 2020.

title: PayDock
text: PayDock is the billing service that issues customer invoices. It is owned by the Payments team. It launched in 2022.

title: Beacon Monitor
text: Beacon Monitor is a dashboard that shows live robot fleet health. It is owned by the Fleet Intelligence team. It launched in 2024.

title: Incident INC-4471
text: Incident INC-4471 affected the Atlas WMS on 2025-02-11. The root cause was an expired TLS certificate. It was resolved by the Security Engineering team.

title: Incident INC-4471 (preliminary report)
text: Preliminary report for incident INC-4471, written before the investigation finished. Incident INC-4471 affected the Atlas WMS on 2025-02-11. The root cause was a DNS outage at the hosting provider. It was resolved by the Fulfillment Platform team.

title: Incident INC-4502
text: Incident INC-4502 affected the SkyLift D3 on 2025-03-04. The root cause was a firmware memory leak. It was resolved by the Fleet Intelligence team.

title: Incident INC-4519
text: Incident INC-4519 affected the Pallet Runner PR-250 on 2025-04-19. The root cause was a misconfigured safety zone map. It was resolved by the Field Operations team.

title: Incident INC-4533
text: Incident INC-4533 affected the PayDock service on 2025-05-02. The root cause was an exhausted database connection pool. It was resolved by the Payments team.

title: Incident INC-4560
text: Incident INC-4560 affected the Pallet Runner PR-200 on 2025-06-23. The root cause was a loose lidar mount. It was resolved by the Robotics Core team.

title: Incident INC-4588
text: Incident INC-4588 affected the TallyScan app on 2025-08-14. The root cause was an expired API token. It was resolved by the Customer Reliability team.

title: Travel policy
text: Under the travel policy, the domestic per diem is 65 USD. Hotel stays above 250 USD per night need director approval. Flights longer than 6 hours may be booked in premium economy.

title: Travel policy (2023 version)
text: This is the 2023 version of the travel policy, kept for reference. Under the travel policy, the domestic per diem is 50 USD. Hotel stays above 200 USD per night need director approval.

title: Expense policy
text: Expense reports must be filed within 30 days of purchase. Receipts are required for any item above 25 USD.

title: On-call policy
text: Engineers on call receive a stipend of 400 USD per week. Pages must be acknowledged within 15 minutes.

title: On-call policy (2022 version)
text: This is the 2022 version of the on-call policy. Engineers on call receive a stipend of 300 USD per week. Pages must be acknowledged within 30 minutes.

title: Remote work policy
text: Employees may work remotely up to 3 days per week. Working remotely from another country needs approval from the People team.

title: Data retention policy
text: Robot telemetry is retained for 18 months. Customer support tickets are retained for 36 months.

title: Hardware returns policy
text: Customers can return unused hardware within 45 days of delivery. Refunds are issued within 10 business days.

title: Quillmoor Robotics overview
text: Quillmoor Robotics builds autonomous robots and software for warehouses. The company was founded in 2013 by chief executive Ines Albright. Its main products are the Pallet Runner line, the SkyLift drones and Atlas WMS.

title: Robot safety guidelines
text: Ground robots must stop within 0.5 meters when a person enters a safety zone. Safety zone maps are reviewed every quarter by the Field Operations team.

title: Warehouse glossary
text: A pick face is the shelf location where an item is picked. A pallet position holds one standard pallet. Replenishment moves stock from reserve storage to pick faces.
